scenes.text: This one fish sold for three point two million dollars.
It's a bluefin tuna, five hundred thirty-five pounds, auctioned before dawn at Tokyo's Toyosu fish market.
The date: January fifth, twenty twenty-six. A new record.
The winner was the sushi chain boss who set the last record in twenty nineteen.
He paid five hundred ten million yen. That's about three point two million dollars.
One fish, worth more than a mansion. Would you pay it? Comment yes or no.
